name: webgl-art-plugin
description: Build reusable artistic websites with an independent HTML/CSS/JavaScript and WebGL runtime, optionally connected to React or Angular through a persistent iframe and validated message bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Build performant HTML/WebGL art with React or Angular.
interface.longDescription: Design and implement artistic websites with semantic HTML fallbacks, an independent WebGL runtime, optional React or Angular hosts, validated iframe messaging, quality tiers, lifecycle controls, and measured performance.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $webgl-art to build a reusable artistic HTML/WebGL experience, choose its React or Angular host boundary, and verify lifecycle, content mapping, and performance.
